instruction: Buy a sweater for Valerie from Amazon in their favorite color (see phone voice message). Get it delivered to their home with gift wrapping. Given the choices, pick the highest rated one.
notes: Two apps (phone, amazon) plus supervisor. Valerie's phone number and home address are discovered via phone.search_contacts; the favorite color is read from her voice message via phone.search_voice_messages filtered by her phone number. amazon.search_products is filtered by product_type=sweater and the favorite color and sorted by rating descending; the single product object `sweater-best` stands for the highest-rated match. The cart is cleared first (amazon.clear_cart) so the placed order contains exactly one item with quantity 1; gift wrapping is added with the same quantity so gift_wrap_quantity == ordered_quantity. Valerie's home address is added as a new amazon address (existing addresses are never updated/deleted, which the evaluation requires); the order ships to that new address_id. Payment card id comes from amazon.show_payment_cards. amazon.search_products needs no token. Static `token-for` facts bind each app to its own token object so the plan maps tokens to the right login. complete_task has no answer; it takes the order/product/address task records only as non-API parameters to carry the goal conditions. Side-effect gmail/file_system changes caused by place_order (receipt email) are not modeled.

plan: (amazon-add-address valerie-addr-name valerie-street valerie-city valerie-state valerie-country valerie-zip amazon-token valerie-home)
(amazon-place-order sierra-card valerie-home amazon-token sweater-best quantity-1 order-1)
